meta: Planning lessons with AI: let AI write the draft in minutes, and teachers keep the most important part. Tell it about your class, ask for the right structure, and check every idea.

muc.title: Planning lessons with AI
muc.text: Many teachers spend their evenings planning lessons, and AI can write the draft in a few minutes so teachers keep the most important part.

muc.title: Tell AI about your class
muc.text: Tell AI the subject, grade, lesson length, the lesson's goal, and where your students are strong or weak.

muc.title: Ask for the right lesson structure
muc.text: Ask AI to follow the familiar structure: warm-up, new knowledge, practice, application, with timing for each part.

muc.title: Check facts and examples
muc.text: Read every point again, especially numbers and examples, then swap generic examples for things close to your students' lives.

muc.title: Three warm-up activities
muc.text: Pick next week's lesson, give AI the goal and what your class is like, ask for three warm-up ideas, then choose the one that fits best.
